marker.title: CHUNKY CREEK
lines: Rain had the creek in flood and the bridge
here out of line when a train bound for
Vicksburg, most of it Confederate soldiers,
went into the water in the dark. Nobody
agrees how many died. Accounts run from
twenty-six names to nearly a hundred.
Choctaw soldiers from a camp nearby went
in after them and brought many out.
